segment.text: Calls to CRC. Communications with a CRC will be recorded or listened into, in accordance with applicable laws, for local operational needs (e.g. for quality or training purposes). Payment card details are not recorded. Where required by law, you will be informed about such recording at the beginning of your call. Email: We analyse your interactions with our content (e.g. click through, the opening of email) to provide you with personalized information based on your interests and preferences. 3. COOKIES/SIMILAR TECHNOLOGIES, LOG FILES AND WEB BEACONS Cookies/Similar Technologies. Please see our Cookie Notice to learn how you can manage your cookie settings and for detailed information on the cookies We use and the purposes for which We use them. Log Files. We collect information in the form of log files that record website activity and gather statistics about your browsing habits. These entries are generated automatically, and help Us to troubleshoot errors, improve performance and maintain the security of our Websites. Web Beacons. Web beacons (also known as "web bugs") are small strings of code that deliver a graphic image on a web page or in an email for the purpose of transferring data back to Us. The information collected via web beacons will include information such as IP Address, as well as information about how you respond to an email campaign (e.g. at what time the email was opened, which links you click on in the email, etc.). We will use web beacons on our Websites or include them in e-mails that We send to you. We use web beacon information for a variety of purposes, including but not limited to, site traffic reporting, unique visitor counts, advertising, email auditing and reporting, and personalisation. 4. USES MADE OF YOUR PERSONAL DATA The following paragraphs describe the various purposes for which We collect and use your Personal Data, and the different types of Personal Data that are collected for each purpose. Please note that not all of the uses below will be relevant to every individual.

How much is it? The amount you pay will vary depending on the subscription plan you select and will be fixed on a monthly basis. 2. When are payments due? The first monthly fee is due at the time you sign up to the Nespresso subscription plan. The monthly fee is to be paid by credit/debit card. The subsequent monthly fees will be payable every month on the same day of the month as when your subscription was activated. 3. What's included in the Nespresso coffee subscription plan? You will receive monthly credit equal to the fee you pay. segment.extended_context: If you have purchased a machine as part of your Plan and wish to terminate your Plan before the end of the initial 24 month Term, you may do so by contacting our Customer Relationship Centre or by visiting a Nespresso Boutique, or by emailing one@nespresso.com. If you terminate before you have paid all 24 Monthly Fees, you will be required to pay a Termination Fee. The Termination Fee will be the appropriate Termination Fee for your selected Plan (which is £70 for the £20 Plan, £110 for the £25 Plan, £140 for the £30 Plan, £160 for the £35 Plan, £200 for the £45 Plan, £350 for the £55 Plan and £550 for the £70 Plan). You will not be charged. If all products in the order are out of stock the Auto-Delivery will be placed on hold. 2.5 Promotions

This monthly fee is fixed and varies depending on the subscription plan you select. If you already have Nespresso credit on your account, this cannot be used to purchase a new Subscription product, nor can you use a Nespresso gift card. 3. Do I have to be a Nespresso Member to purchase a subscription plan? If you are not already a Nespresso Member, you will need to register via Nespresso.com or at one of our Boutiques to sign up for any of our subscription plans. 4. Definition of Nespresso Credit Each month, you will receive a fixed amount of Nespresso Credit that you can use to purchase Nespresso coffee, accessories or coffee machines on Nespresso.com, with the Nespresso App, by phone, or in our Nespresso Boutiques. Nespresso Credit is non-refundable and non-transferable and may not be exchanged for a cash equivalent. You can check your current balance of Nespresso Credit by logging into your account on Nespresso.com or visiting one of our Boutiques. Nespresso reserves the right to terminate the payment of the extra Nespresso Credit at any time without giving any reason, or prior notice. 5. What happens if I don't have enough Nespresso Credit to meet the minimum order size for coffee orders? We understand that your monthly subscription plan may not always provide enough Nespresso Credit to meet the minimum order requirements of 50 capsules for delivered orders (placed via nespresso.com, Nespresso App or Nespresso Customer Relationship Centre), so you could consider: • Opting to use your Nespresso Credit plus your credit card to make up the extra. This way you can still enjoy the benefits of your subscription plan and your Nespresso coffee and accessories. • Opting to order coffee via your subscription plan every two (2) or more months (with no impact on your coffee's freshness). • Accumulate your Nespresso Credit to save for your favourite Nespresso coffee and accessories. 6. Card updates If you have authorised it with your bank we may automatically update your card when the expiry date is reached. 7.Failed payments If you fail to pay the monthly fee, Nespresso's automated system will reattempt again until successful for three consecutive days. Any outstanding balance will be carried forward so the next payment due will be for the previous month and the current month. 8. Security checks To ensure that your credit card is not being used without your consent, we reserve the right to validate name, address and other personal information supplied by you during the order process against appropriate third-party databases. We also reserve the right to perform a credit check. By accepting these supplementary Terms

To exercise this right, you must inform us of your decision by a clear statement during the Cooling Off Perio to our Customer Relationship Centre. If you cancel your Plan during the Cooling Off Period, we will repay to you all payments received from you, including delivery charges (except for supplementary costs arising if you chose a type of delivery other than our least expensive standard delivery). We will repay you using the same method of payment as you used to pay us. You will not incur any fees as a result of the repayment. You must send back, or hand over to us, the unused Nespresso machine and any capsules that you have received, or that were in transit at the time you notified us that you were exercising your right to cancel. We will make the repayment without undue delay, and in any event no later than 14 days after we have received the Nespresso machine and any capsules back from you, or, if earlier, 14 days after you provide evidence that you have returned them. If you cancel before you have received the Nespresso machine or any capsules, we will repay you within 14 days of the date you inform us that you are cancelling the Nespresso subscription plan. We may withhold repayment until we have received the unused Nespresso machine and any capsules back from you. If you terminate before you have paid all 24 Monthly Fees, you will be required to pay a Termination Fee. By submitting any information required as part of their participation in the campaign, participants agree to their information being held and processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Data Protection Act 2018. 1. This promotion is open to all residents of the UK, Channel Islands, Isle of Man and Republic of Ireland, aged 18 or over and excludes employees and their immediate families of Nestlé S.A. and Nespresso, its agents or anyone professionally connected to the promotion. Participants must register or be registered with Nespresso to qualify for the offer. 2. The offer is available to qualifying Nespresso Members who purchase a qualifying Nespresso machine from a Nespresso direct channel including Nespresso Customer Call Centre on 0800 442 442 (UK) or 1800 812 660 (ROI), or on-line at www.nespresso.com, or via the Nespresso App, or via a Nespresso Boutique between 12.11.25 and 23:59 on 02.12.25. The promotion only applies to new Nespresso machines purchased within the stated promotional period and cannot be applied retrospectively. 3. Maximum of one offer per machine purchased per Nespresso Member. Any additional machines purchased during the stated promotional period will not qualify for the offer. The qualifying Nespresso Coffee machine must be purchased in the UK, Channel Island, Isle of Man or Republic of Ireland. 4. How to Claim: Participants must visit the Nespresso website at www.nespresso.com and complete their purchase online, or place their order via the Nespresso App, or the Nespresso Customer Call Centre on 0800 442 442 (UK) or 1800 812 660 (ROI), or via a Nespresso Boutique. Offer not available via any other retailer. The offer can be redeemed by adding a qualifying machine to the basket. The offer will automatically be applied at checkout. Participants will be required to register/be registered with Nespresso to claim the offer. Registration can take up to 24hrs to complete. Any additional machines purchased during the stated promotional period will not qualify for the offer. The complimentary coffee pods will be made up of a pre-selected Vertuo or Original range chosen by Nespresso which cannot be changed/substituted for any other variants. The selection is subject to change based on availability. N.B. The pre-selected free coffee pods are a special promotional package only and not available for purchase.

segment.text: To maintain your Nespresso & YOU membership, you must have made at least one valid coffee order in the last 12 months. Corporate bodies, partnerships, trade associations and other commercial bodies are eligible but only one membership is available per person. Joint or family membership is not available. Persons under 18 years of age are excluded. Employees of Nestlé, Nespresso or any associated entities, its agents or anyone else professionally connected with the Nespresso & YOU programme will not be eligible to membership benefits. 3. Membership Benefits Connoisseur: Connoisseur level is achieved as soon as you place your first coffee order with us. Customers who have four (4) years or less continuous membership and/or purchase less than 550 pods every 12-month period will be deemed to be Connoisseur level. If you are a Nespresso Subscription customer, you will be upgraded directly to Ambassador tier. If no valid purchases are made in any given 12 months, you will lose your benefits. Expert: Customers who have between five (5) and nine (9) years continuous membership and/or purchase between 550 and 1,100 pods every 12-month period for four (4) continuous years will be deemed to be Expert level. If the required threshold of pods is not purchased every year for the four anniversary (12 month) periods, your membership tier will return to Connoisseur. If no valid purchases are made in any given 12 months, you will lose your benefits. Ambassador: Customers who have more than 10 years of continuous membership and/or purchase more than 1,100 pods every 12 months for nine (9) continuous years and/or are a Nespresso Subscription customer will be deemed to be Ambassador level. segment.text: The Promoter takes data protection seriously. By entering this promotion, participants confirm that they have read the Privacy Policy and agree to these Terms and Conditions of the promotion. By submitting any information required as part of their participation into the promotion, participants agree to their information being held and processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Data Protection Act 2018. 1.1. ELIGIBILITY • There are two (2) categories available for entry: • Group One -Young Creators - Open to anyone in full-time primary or secondary education (typically ages 5 - 16). Entrants must live in UK or the Republic of Ireland. • Submissions must be sent by the entrant's parent or legal guardian. Maximum one (1) entry per participant. All artwork must be original and the entrant's own work and must not infringe any copyrights. • Group Two - Open Category - Open to anyone aged over 16 (General Public). • Entrants must be aged over 16 years old and live in the UK or the Republic of Ireland. Submissions must be sent by the entrant themselves. Maximum one (1) entry per participant. All submitted entries must be the entrant's own original work and must not infringe any copyrights. • Employees and their immediate families of the Promoter, its agents or anyone else professionally associated with this promotion are excluded. 1.2. ENTRY CRITERIA Participants can enter a maximum of one (1) design and must follow the mandatory guidance laid out by Nespresso, which requests the following: • Submissions must be a visual response: can include (but not limited to) lettering, illustrations, patterns or graphical treatments of visuals that can be printed on a NESPRESSO Recycling Bag. Submissions will only be considered if it can be easily converted to a format suitable for printing onto recycling bags with a maximum of three (3) colours. • Submissions must be A5 Portrait or Landscape in size and as a PDF, PNG or JPEG format with a maximum file size of 10 MG. • All submissions must be the entrant's own, original work (no stock images or AI generated images permitted). • Entrants are encouraged to create eye-catching designs that represent the theme 'Inspired by Nature' and reflect ideas of sustainability and recycling • Designs should use up to 3 bold or vibrant colours • Successful submissions will be printed on NESPRESSO Recycling Bags which will be launched in 2026 or sooner. • Designs must be impactful/eye catching and have good standout for collection agencies. • Entries must be submitted by no later than 23:59 on 14.09.25. • Each submission must include the entrant's name, contact details and a short rationale about the inspiration behind the design.

segment.text: • Submissions must be A5 portrait format. Designs should not include any Nespresso branding, instructions, bar code or other key information. These elements will be added/positioned by Nespresso to the winning designs. The winning designs may need to be adjusted to allow placement of such essential assets. • N.B. Designs do not need to be submitted on an actual template. • Entrants must retain an original copy or a high-resolution scan of their artwork. ENTRY 2.1. COMPETITION STAGE 1: • Entry to the competition must be made via the official Entry Form available at: https://www.nestle-promotions.co.uk/nespresso-recycling only by no later than 23:59 on 14.09.25. No other entry methods will be available. STAGE 2: • All entries will be reviewed against the Entry Criteria (1.2) and shortlisted down to 15 designs from each category (15 Young Creators' Designs and 15 General Public). In the event there are more than 200 entries per category, entries will be put forward into a random selection process, using an independently verified computer programme and the first 200 valid selected entries will then be judged. STAGE 3: • These entries will then be shortlisted through a judging process and panel into four (4) shortlisted winners from each category. • The two (2) ultimate winners (one from each category) will be announced on 26.09.25 via Instagram. • Production of the new design recycling bag is currently planned for November 2025, but subject to confirmation. 3.1. ENTRIES • Any late entries received after the closing date will not be included in the judging process. • No purchase necessary. 4.1 JUDGING • The Judging Panel will comprise of the following members: Nespresso Representative Recycling Partner Representative Artist Independent Adjudicator • In the event of unforeseen circumstances, Nespresso reserve the right to amend the list of judges with alternative suitable substitutes. The total panel will consist of 4 - 6 people, including at least one (1) independent auditor. • In the event of a tie in selecting the four (4) finalists, the Nespresso representative will have the final casting vote. 4.2. SHORTLISTING CRITERIA • The judging criteria will be based on the judging specifications:: • Follow the theme of 'inspired by nature': This includes inspiration from themes of nature such as (but not limited to) Forests, Trees, Seas, Marine/Aquatic Life, Rivers, Clean Air and wildlife. • Reflect ideas of sustainability and recycling: Does the design help to encourage recycling behaviours?
